scientific.integrity: The primary journal full text and the earlier thesis chapter were materially inspected. Candidate-specific searches covered exact object names, invariant notation, centrally symmetric quadrilateral aliases, and the radial-monotonicity formulation. The proof is analytic; deterministic computation is used only as a regression check.
limitations: The theorem is restricted to parallelograms; it does not assert N=2 for arbitrary centrally symmetric polygons or convex bodies.
The circle-intersection invariant is Euclidean rather than affine, so affine images of other classes require separate analysis.
The short proof leaves a residual risk of an unindexed folklore observation.
The earlier thesis front matter is month-dated; 2013-05-08 is the earliest exact public date verified for the journal source.

title: Erdős's circle conjecture is exact on all parallelograms
